summary: Added Playwright end to end tests (e2e/): behaviour and computed-colour checks of the demo notes app, and navigation, charts, demo banner and live panel checks of the dashboard. Jobs: e2e_local in verify (app started in the job) and e2e_live in release after both deploys, so request_fix sees its failures. The Playwright image tag was read from mcr.microsoft.com and is pinned with a test that checks it equals e2e/requirements.txt. The demo page gets an explicit brand colour for the button. Documented in docs/e2e.md.
